method: Actual persisted screenshot pixels inspected separately for all 24 target contexts; source relationships compared with full-source specification and saved accepted PNGs. Automated screenshot completion was not treated as semantic approval.

reviews.review_notes: Both dated and permanent captures show the full boundary-crossing image and nearby publisher-evidence context. Desktop labels and independent controls are clear. Mobile labels are compact but each required phrase remains visually distinguishable, including URL workarounds and the limited-impact qualifier; no image clipping, text overlap or missing mechanism region. The stop-cross under Offline tests is a diagram rejection marker, not source prose. Source pairing verified by captured heading, exact src/alt and independent HTML readback.
